# Test fixtures

`fixture.AppImage` (generated by `tools/make_fixture.sh`) is a **synthetic
4 KiB Type-2 ELF** that is *not* a runnable AppImage. It exists so the v1
inspector can be tested without a real squashfs payload:

- `format::detect` returns `Type2Elf` (starts with `\x7fELF`).
- `elf_offset::find` finds the `squashfs` ELF section and verifies `hsqs`
  magic (little-endian `0x73717368`) at the claimed offset.

It intentionally contains **no embedded icon** and **no `.DirIcon`** — v1
always synthesizes icons and never calls `unsquashfs`, so no real payload is
needed. v2 (embedded-icon extraction) will need real AppImages; this fixture
will not change then, only new fixtures will be added.

Regenerate:
```sh
tools/make_fixture.sh tests/fixtures/fixture.AppImage
```
